items.title: A Day in the Life of Someone Who Just Wanted to Open LinkedIn in Peace
items.pt:
All I wanted was a referral. LinkedIn had other plans.

Every morning, I open LinkedIn with a very simple intention.

Find a recruiter.
Connect with someone working at a company I like.
Maybe send a cold DM.
Perhaps find a job opening that doesn't require 7 years of experience for an entry-level position.

Simple. Reasonable. Harmless.

And then LinkedIn loads.

"I'm thrilled to announce..." 

Oh, we're doing this again.🔪🔪🔪🔪🔪

Someone has joined a company. Someone has completed an internship. So

items.title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
items.pt: Agent harnesses have emerged as a promising mechanism for continual learning, alongside test-time parametric learning. However, the current benchmarks have several limitations: they generally focus on a single applied domain, serve each instance only once, and assume a single family of learner, so memory-based and weight-based systems are rarely compared on the same scale. items.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
items.pt: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. items.title: Measuring Robustness and Efficiency in a Connectome-Constrained Fly Visual System Model: Linking an Adversarial and a Perceptual Illusion
items.pt: Biological visual systems compute reliably under tight metabolic and wiring constraints, whereas artificial vision systems consume far more energy and can be sensitive to adversarial perturbations. Whether networks with brain-like wiring are more robust at lower computational cost is unclear. items.title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
items.pt: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows.
